# The Express Tribune

> Pakistan's leading English-language news outlet delivering breaking news on domestic politics, Middle East tensions, business markets, and international affairs with real-time coverage.

The Express Tribune is a major Pakistani news organization covering national and international stories with emphasis on Pakistan-Iran-Middle East geopolitics, PSX markets, sports, and lifestyle content. The platform serves as a primary source for English-language news consumers in Pakistan and the diaspora.

## Key Topics

- Pakistan news
- Middle East tensions
- Iran conflict
- Breaking news
- International news
- Geopolitics
- PSX stock market
- Cricket & sports
- Business & economy
- Regional conflict
- Eid coverage
- Missile strikes
- Energy crisis
- PIA
- UAE & Gulf region

## News & Breaking Updates

- [Homepage](https://tribune.com.pk): Breaking news on Pakistan, Iran, Middle East conflicts and regional updates
- [Latest News](https://tribune.com.pk/latest): Real-time news aggregation with breaking updates, sports and international coverage
- [Today's Newspaper](https://tribune.com.pk/today-paper): Digital newspaper edition with Pakistan news, headlines and current events
- [Trump warns of massive retaliation after Israel strike on Iran gas field escalates energy war](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2598399/trump-warns-of-massive-retaliation-after-israel-strike-on-iran-gas-field-escalates-energy-war): Breaking news on Israel-Iran military escalation and energy infrastructure attacks
- [PIA refutes claims its flight escaped missile attack near UAE's Fujairah](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2598452/pia-refutes-claims-its-flight-escaped-missile-attack-near-uaes-fujairah): PIA statement denying missile attack claims near Fujairah amid Middle East tensions
- [China condemns killing of Iranian leaders, attacks on civilians](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2598429/china-condemns-killing-of-iranian-leaders-attacks-on-civilians): China's diplomatic statement opposing force in Iran conflict and civilian attacks

## Regional News

- [Pakistan](https://tribune.com.pk/pakistan): Pakistan news section covering domestic politics, security and provincial updates
- [World](https://tribune.com.pk/world): International news on Iran conflict, Middle East tensions and global diplomacy
- [Ruet-e-Hilal Committee to meet today for Shawwal moon sighting](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2598455/ruet-e-hilal-committee-to-meet-today-for-shawwal-moon-sighting): Eid announcement meeting by Ruet-e-Hilal Committee for Shawwal moon sighting
- [Thunderstorms, heavy rain likely in Karachi today as temperatures set to drop](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2598416/thunderstorms-heavy-rain-likely-in-karachi-today-as-temperatures-set-to-drop): Weather forecast for Karachi and Sindh with thunderstorm and temperature warnings

## Business & Markets

- [Business](https://tribune.com.pk/business): Business news with PSX stock market, commodity prices and economic analysis
- [Gold price in Pakistan today - March 19, 2026](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2598443/gold-prices-drop-sharply-in-global-local-markets-ahead-of-eid): Gold and silver price updates in Pakistan affected by Middle East conflict

## Sports, Technology & Entertainment

- [Sports](https://tribune.com.pk/sports): Sports coverage including cricket, football, Champions League and live scores
- [Technology](https://tribune.com.pk/technology): Technology news on AI, cybersecurity, data breaches and smartphone security
- [Life Style](https://tribune.com.pk/life-style): Lifestyle and entertainment news covering celebrities, culture and events

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Opinion](https://tribune.com.pk/opinion): Opinion columns on Pakistan politics, geopolitics and editorial commentary
- [Blogs & Commentary](https://tribune.com.pk/blogs): User blogs and commentary on geopolitics, economics and international affairs

## Optional

- [Slideshows](https://tribune.com.pk/multimedia/slideshows): Photo galleries, cartoons and multimedia content from Pakistan cities
